_comment: Each step of the Information Protection kit, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls it supports and the FedRAMP Key Security Indicators aligned to them. The pairs are the information protection implementation guide's 'Requirements and KSIs' table, which carries them from Book 20, Appendix A (checked there against the NIST catalog and fedramp.gov on Nov 11, 2026). Control parts are short paraphrases, not NIST's text. KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with them and doesn't report KSIs itself. Which step supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides. 'stages' lists the steps each stage's evidence must hold before the go/no-go.

AC-4.title: Information Flow Enforcement
AC-4.part: enforce approved authorizations for the flow of information within and between systems

AC-5.title: Separation of Duties
AC-5.part: identify duties to separate and support them with access authorizations

AC-6.title: Least Privilege
AC-6.part: allow only the access users and processes need

AC-16.title: Security and Privacy Attributes
AC-16.part: associate security attributes with information and keep them with it

AC-21.title: Information Sharing
AC-21.part: help users decide whether a sharing partner's authorizations match the information's restrictions

AU-6.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
AU-6.part: review and analyze audit records and report findings

AU-11.title: Audit Record Retention
AU-11.part: retain audit records for a defined period

AU-12.title: Audit Record Generation
AU-12.part: generate audit records for the events identified

CA-7.title: Continuous Monitoring
CA-7.part: a continuous monitoring strategy with metrics and assessment frequencies

CM-3.title: Configuration Change Control
CM-3.part: review, approve, document and monitor configuration-controlled changes

CM-12.title: Information Location
CM-12.part: identify and document where specified information is processed and stored

IR-4.title: Incident Handling
IR-4.part: handle incidents from preparation to recovery

MP-3.title: Media Marking
MP-3.part: mark media with distribution limitations and security markings

MP-7.title: Media Use
MP-7.part: restrict or prohibit the use of types of media

PM-5(1).title: System Inventory | Inventory of Personally Identifiable Information
PM-5(1).part: maintain an inventory of what processes PII

RA-2.title: Security Categorization
RA-2.part: categorize the system and its information

SC-13.title: Cryptographic Protection
SC-13.part: implement the cryptography the organization requires

SI-4.title: System Monitoring
SI-4.part: monitor for attacks and unauthorized activity

ACCESS.title: The snapshot's tenant and the Purview role register (guide G1, G10)

INVENTORY.title: Classes, sensitive information types and content counts (guide G1)

LABELS.title: Labels, label policies and container labels (guide G2 to G4)

PROTECTION.title: Rights Management, recovery, message encryption and co-authoring (guide G5 to G7)

DLP.title: DLP stages and the exception register (guide G8, G11)

AUTOLABEL.title: Auto-labeling stages and custom sensitive information types (guide G9)

AUDIT.title: Audit on, retained, and the synthetic events (guide G10)
